Mixture weights from the doubly-coded postings of a parent group

Source: R/reference_professions.R
group_mixture_weights.Rd

For every code of the starting classification, the distribution of the arrival codes among the doubly-coded postings of the code's whole parent group, optionally leaving out the code's own postings. The weights feed transfer_skill_profile_mixture().

Usage

group_mixture_weights(
  postings,
  from_col,
  to_col,
  group,
  leave_one_out = FALSE,
  from_na = c("", "Unclassifiable"),
  to_na = c("", "Unclassifiable")
)

Arguments

postings

A data.frame with one row per posting and the columns from_col and to_col.

from_col, to_col

Names of the starting and arrival code columns.

group

A data.frame with columns code and parent: the parent group of each starting code (for example the universe of build_reference_professions()). Every code of group gets the weights of its parent; postings whose starting code is not in group are ignored.

leave_one_out

If TRUE, the doubly-coded postings of the code itself are removed from its weights. Default FALSE.

from_na, to_na

Values of the two code columns that mean "no code".

Value

A data.table with code, parent, ref_code (arrival code) and weight (number of doubly-coded postings of the group with that arrival code, minus the code's own with leave_one_out = TRUE), one row per code and arrival code with positive weight, sorted by code and ref_code. Codes whose group has no doubly-coded postings (or, leaving one out, none besides their own) have no row.

Examples

postings <- data.table::data.table(
  esco = c("1000.1", "1000.1", "1000.2", "2000.1"),
  cp = c("1.1.1.1.0", "1.1.1.1.0", "1.1.1.2.0", "")
)
group <- data.table::data.table(
  code = c("1000.1", "1000.2", "2000.1"),
  parent = c("1000", "1000", "2000")
)
group_mixture_weights(postings, "esco", "cp", group)
#>      code parent  ref_code weight
#>    <char> <char>    <char>  <num>
#> 1: 1000.1   1000 1.1.1.1.0      2
#> 2: 1000.1   1000 1.1.1.2.0      1
#> 3: 1000.2   1000 1.1.1.1.0      2
#> 4: 1000.2   1000 1.1.1.2.0      1
group_mixture_weights(postings, "esco", "cp", group, leave_one_out = TRUE)
#> Key: <code, ref_code>
#>      code parent  ref_code weight
#>    <char> <char>    <char>  <num>
#> 1: 1000.1   1000 1.1.1.2.0      1
#> 2: 1000.2   1000 1.1.1.1.0      2
